audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields (whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid twice, late, wants.you[1]) build the level-6 plan around hijacking 'Abyssal Voyage' — an ability that does not exist in Tahm Kench's current kit.
audit.why: Abyssal Voyage is his PRE-REWORK ultimate. His R is now Devour. The page's whole narrative — 'you roam with his own tool while he is stranded' — describes a champion that has not existed for years. suspectNames is empty because the detector only catches near-misses, not obsolete names.
audit.corrected: Hijack copies Devour: a few seconds with the target eaten and unable to act, at 100 mana and no cooldown of its own.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the player that a hijacked Devour cannot be cast on demand.
audit.why: Devour requires three stacks of An Acquired Taste on the target, and Sylas does not inherit Tahm Kench's stacks — his own basic attacks build them. So a stolen Devour needs three autos landed first. The mirror auditor established this and it directly kills the 'steal it and roam' plan the page sells.
audit.corrected: A hijacked Devour is a finisher after three autos, never an opener. Restated from Sylas's side rather than re-derived.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slots are scrambled: wants.you[2] calls Devour 'his Devour (W)', wants.foe[1] calls Abyssal Dive 'Abyssal Dive (R)', and seven fields attribute grey health to 'his grey-health passive'.
audit.why: Devour is R, Abyssal Dive is W, and grey health is Thick Skin (E) — a 3-second-cooldown store-and-convert. The actual passive is An Acquired Taste, which is what turns Tongue Lash into a stun at three stacks and unlocks Devour.
audit.corrected: Reassigned each mechanic to its real slot. The clock in this lane is his stack count, not any cooldown — Devour's cooldown is 0.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill / Tahm Kench / Tahm Kench / Skill / Skill / Tahm Kench / Tahm Kench. The packet chart is Skill / Skill / Sylas / Skill / Sylas / Sylas / Skill.
audit.why: The content whys already argue the packet's version on every disputed row: whys[1] 'short trades now favour you marginally', whys[2] 'giving you a real lead', whys[5] 'sustained fights are almost unwinnable for him', whys[6] 'you the higher-agency carry'. Sylas 51.7% over 352 games supports it. The mirror proposed no chart change, so it is silent rather than contradicting.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 moved to the packet chart as matched full+content pairs, with ratings raised on the three Sylas rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls a wasted Abyssal Dive a 'fifteen-second invitation', and spikes[3].when labels Abyssal Dive as 'Tahm Kench Lvl 6'.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is 21/20/19/18/17 and is his W — available from level 2, not 6. The spike text itself is accurate; only its timing label was wrong.
audit.corrected: 21 seconds at rank 1, online from level 2-3.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'early' paragraph says 'fire E2 chain to hook and stun him' and describes Tongue Lash as an unconditional stun that 'stuns for a full second'.
audit.why: Abscond/Abduct has no stun in Riot's text or flags. Tongue Lash stuns ONLY when the target already has three stacks of An Acquired Taste; otherwise it damages and slows. The stun duration is not in this data.
audit.corrected: Recorded; the specific claim about duration is left alone rather than replaced with a guess. The conditional nature of the stun is written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is mentioned once in passing in report[8].t and never justified.
audit.why: Tongue Lash heals him on every champion hit, and Thick Skin converts stored damage into healing out of combat and into a shield on demand. Two independent sustain sources, both flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds timing is what decides the extended trade this page keeps telling the player to seek.

notes: Worst page in my shard. Six fields built the entire level-6 plan around hijacking 'Abyssal Voyage', Tahm Kench's pre-rework ultimate, which does not exist — the player was being told to steal a roam tool and leave him 'stranded top'. The mirror auditor found the same string 182 times across champ-data/content/tahmkench.js, so this is champion-wide and worth a dedicated sweep, not just per-matchup patching. On top of that the slots were scrambled three ways (Devour labelled W, Abyssal Dive labelled R, grey health attributed to the passive instead of Thick Skin) and the real gate — three stacks of An Acquired Taste, which Sylas has to build with his OWN autos before a hijacked Devour will fire — appeared nowhere. I moved five chart rows to the packet because every content why already argued for them; the mirror is silent on the chart rather than opposed, so this is the one place in my shard where I moved rows without mirror confirmation.
